request.subject: UNIT:EMBARKED_TRANSPORT

layers.text: Style: bold chibi pixel art for a playful turn-based strategy board game, a board game come to life: chunky simple shapes, flat colours with one shadow tone, low detail, clean readable silhouette that reads at a glance at small size, slightly silly and cheerful.
layers.negative: photorealism, painterly brushwork, gradients, dithering, noise, tiny details, thin outline, low-poly 3D, faceted polygons, blur, text, letters, numbers, logo, UI, frame, health bar, selection ring, cropped subject

layers.text: Camera: consistent strategy-game camera, three-quarter view looking slightly down, the subject faces down and to the right (south-east), whole subject visible and centred on a transparent background, nothing cropped. The subject stands directly on the empty transparent background: nothing at all is drawn under it.

Faction: cheerful, practical storybook medieval. Everything is made of woven cloth, light steel, pale birch wood, cream plaster and beige cobblestone, with stitched hems, steel rivets and carved trims as details; cloth is shaded with a deeper tone of its own colour, steel with darker blue-grey, wood with darker straw yellow, plaster and stone with cool grey, never brown.
layers.negative: gun, musket, rifle, pistol, cannon, gunpowder, top hat, bicorne, tricorne, Napoleonic uniform, modern clothing, steel plate full armour, magic glow, glowing runes, wings, bronze, copper, rust, brown boots, brown leather, dark brown shading, red-brown

layers.text: Class: one chunky cute boat map piece, a single small wooden vessel with a big simple hull, thick single-colour black outline, big simple shapes. It floats on the empty transparent background: nothing is drawn under or around the hull, no water, no waves and no shadow; the bottom of the hull is the lowest thing in the image.
layers.negative: water, sea, waves, ripples, foam, splash, wake, reflection, shadow, island, rock, pedestal, base, plinth, disc, rim, ground plate, platform, dock, pier, jetty, ground tile, grass, soil, scenery, background, second boat, fleet, crowd

layers.text: Team colour: large solid bright red (#d8262c) areas are the maskable owner colour and must be clearly visible from a distance, about a quarter to a third of the subject. No other red or red-brown anywhere: every other material, and its shading, uses colours that are clearly not red or red-brown.

Subject: Embarked transport, a chunky cute wide flat-bottomed wooden cargo barge seen from the front-right, low and wide with no mast and no sail: a pale birch-wood hull with a pale straw-yellow plank line, two pale wooden oars resting out of the sides, a big heap of cargo in the middle covered by a large bright red canvas tarp tied down with pale rope, a short pale wooden pole at the stern with a small bright red pennant; simple shapes and very few details; clearly a slow troop and cargo boat, not a warship.
The whole hull, deck, masts and oars are pale straw-yellow birch wood with a slightly darker straw-yellow shade, never brown or orange.
layers.negative: mast, sail, cannon, gun, sailor, person, character, soldier, brown wood, dark brown hull, red-brown, orange wood, barrels
